english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for reporting something heard or claimed by other people.
Use this when the information comes from something the speaker has heard or learned from reports, rather than from direct appearance or deduction.

examples.english: They’re supposedly coming back to Hong Kong tomorrow.
examples.jyutping: teng1 gong2 keoi5 ting1 jat6 wui5 faan1 hoeng1 gong2

examples.english: Apparently, that shop has closed down.
examples.jyutping: teng1 gong2 go2 gaan1 pou3 tau4 zap1 zo2 lap1
